versions.changelog:
Initial release of Skill Sentinel – diagnose, fix, and prevent agent skill trigger failures.

- Provides step-by-step workflow to audit, fix, and verify skill triggering issues.
- Covers common causes: missing trigger conditions, YAML frontmatter errors, token budget overflow, skill discovery problems, and poorly scoped descriptions.
- Supplies best practice patterns for writing high-accuracy skill descriptions.
- Includes automated scripts for auditing, auto-remediation, and conflict detection.
- Offers guidance on token budget management and proactive calibration using real trigger failures.
